name: Lust Age: New Home
source:
Lust Age: New Home is a free Adult Visual Novel, Dating-Sim game with RPG and Sandbox elements featuring a wholesome harem theme!

One day, you're just a guy who's turned 21, and the next day... you're still the same guy! But suddenly, you receive some unexpected news: you have to move to a place inhabited only by women. That's great, isn't it?

You're a normal guy living a normal life (boring!), but fate has something very special in store for you: becoming the future Champion of Gold Valley (wait, what?).

Experience all kinds of adventures in your new life alongside lots of girls you'll meet along the way! Earn their trust and make all the girls fall in love with you!

Did I mention that you'll be living in a Manor alongside other girls you'll meet along the way? Now you know!

But be aware! There is an evil force tormenting the world... Who could it be? You'll have to find out for yourself. Don't worry, you were born for this!
